outcome.agentText:
The write was refused by a pre-tool hook with the following verbatim message:

```text
Encountered error in tool execution: tool call denied by pre-tool hook: No-else guard blocked this write to hook-probe.ts.
Why: it adds 1 net-new else statement(s):
  export function pick(flag: boolean) { if (flag) { return 1; } else { return 2; } }
Fix: invert the condition and return, continue, break, or throw early; replace else-if chains with guard clauses, a lookup map, or a switch with early returns.
Ternaries, Rust let-else, Python for/while/try/except else, and Ruby begin/rescue else are exempt.
```
